description: This file defines a handler class for undoing approval of recurring deposit account applications within the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the undo operation to a service, handling commands related to the RECURRINGDEPOSITACCOUNT entity with the APPROVALUNDO action.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountApplicationApprovalUndoCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles undoing the approval of recurring deposit account applications, implementing the command handler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Executes the undo approval process for a recurring deposit account application using the provided command.
